contract.classification: synthetic dimensionless software experiment; CFO stress values are not measured or physically calibrated
contract.protocol_status: v4 exploratory continuous carrier-frequency-offset sweep; conditions frozen in source before the full run; not a formal preregistration or physical validation
contract.preservation: digital_to_wave.py and all v1-v3 source, tests, reports, and result artifacts are used without modification

noise_model.name: iid_gaussian_sample_noise
noise_model.construction: seeded NumPy normal draws on waveform samples; both receiver methods decode the same received realization

carrier_frequency_offset_model.name: synthetic_continuous_linear_phase_ramp
carrier_frequency_offset_model.equation: q[k,n]=sin((omega0+2*pi*delta_cycles/64)*(64*k+n)+pi/4), for global sample index 64*k+n; signed input multiplies q
carrier_frequency_offset_model.phase_continuity: CFO phase is continuous across the 32 segments; the known sign phase is retained; segment timing and frame boundary are exact
carrier_frequency_offset_model.level_basis: explicit synthetic stress grid only; no device oscillator, channel trace, or physical operating range was supplied

decoder_methods.nominal_existing_decoder: unchanged digital_to_wave.decode_wave using the nominal 4-cycle/64-sample local template and exact segment framing; it is not CFO-compensated
decoder_methods.oracle_known_frequency: analysis-only upper-bound receiver with exact CFO and frame timing supplied; projects each segment onto its exact frequency-shifted template and divides by that template's energy; not an implementation candidate or included in existing decoder
decoder_methods.weak_zero_output_floor: always returns zeros; recorded once against each fixed vector at zero CFO; ignores the waveform and is not a competing decoder

contract.frame_pass_rule: inclusive: all 32 absolute component errors must be <= 0.25
contract.seed_streams: NumPy SeedSequence([master_seed, cfo_level_index, vector_index]); paired receiver methods share each noise realization

analytic_calibration.nominal_estimator: xhat_k=(r_k dot q0)/32; under CFO its mean gain is (qk dot q0)/32 and sample-noise SD is sigma/sqrt(32)
analytic_calibration.oracle_estimator: xhat_k=(r_k dot qk)/(qk dot qk); under IID Gaussian sample noise its error is N(0,sigma^2/(qk dot qk))
analytic_calibration.frame_probability: product over 32 independent components of P(-0.25 <= Normal(bias_k,sd_k) <= 0.25); at sigma=0 use the exact deterministic pass rule
analytic_calibration.pooled_probability: equal-weight mean of the six fixed-pattern theoretical frame probabilities; observed pooled Wilson interval is conditional on this vector panel

source_basis.relevance: documents CFO as a separate impairment whose phase accumulates linearly over time, and distinguishes sample-clock offset
communications textbook treatment of carrier recovery and receiver local-oscillator frequency offset

metric_definitions.frame_pass_share: passing frames divided by frames; pass iff every absolute component error is <= 0.25
metric_definitions.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% Wilson score interval for Monte Carlo pass shares; deterministic clean/floor rows have no interval
metric_definitions.uncertainty_scope: intervals quantify only IID simulation variation conditional on the six fixed vectors and stated synthetic model; they do not quantify model or physical uncertainty
metric_definitions.component_errors: empirical MAE, RMSE, mean signed error, and population variance across all decoded vector components

results.uncertainty_kind: two-sided 95% Wilson interval; conditional on fixed vector panel and synthetic IID draws
